statement: A dissolved Delaware corporation continues as a body corporate for 3 years after dissolution (or longer if the Court of Chancery directs) for the purpose of prosecuting and defending suits and gradually settling and closing its business, but not for continuing the business for which it was organized (8 Del. C. § 278).
caveat: Claims handling during wind-down can follow the § 280-281 notice procedures or the default § 281(b) route, with different director-liability consequences. This repo does not advise on claim reserves.
reviewer: Lane editorial review (law-map 2026-10-14); independent domain expert review pending
